## Build folder
Make sure there is a build folder in your Hello-World folder
If the build folder does not exist, hover over the project folder name "Hello-World" in the left hand Explorer navigation window.
You will see an icon for adding a folder. Select  "New Folder" and name the folder, build


## To build, run the following commands in the terminal

cd build

cmake ..

make 

## to run the program
### from the build directory ( you might need to "cd build" if you aren't already there)
./hello
